courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: 船舶完整穩度分析
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 船體尺度、載荷條件、海況及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Vessel scale, load conditions, sea state and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 本專題以排水量一致的船型比較建立起點，接到負載元牽引力正規化的系統介面，最後用阻力曲線與限制交接整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Begin with Comparing hulls at equal displacement, connect through Normalizing tow-force measurements, then integrate evidence using Handing over resistance curves and limits. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

history.title: 船舶線型與阻力試驗
history.titleEn: Ship hull forms and resistance testing
history.text: 本專題以排水量一致的船型比較建立起點，接到負載元牽引力正規化的系統介面，最後用阻力曲線與限制交接整合證據。這是原創教學進程，不是假稱現場工程紀錄。
history.textEn: Begin with Comparing hulls at equal displacement, connect through Normalizing tow-force measurements, then integrate evidence using Handing over resistance curves and limits. This is an original teaching progression, not a claimed field record.

courses.connection: 以兩個假想船型的拖曳曲線區分尺度、黏性與波浪阻力，避免只挑最低阻力點。 在船型模型與拖曳資料實驗室依十個單元完成機制觀察、定量比較、量測驗證與故障診斷；各算例為獨立教學假設，完整保留資料來源與模型限制。
courses.connectionEn: Distinguish scale, viscous and wave effects in two synthetic hull tow curves rather than selecting one minimum-drag point. Complete ten units of mechanisms, quantitative comparisons, measurement verification and diagnosis in the Hull-model and towing-data laboratory. Examples are independent teaching assumptions with sources and model limitations retained.
